rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for an unfilled job position.

example.english: There is still a vacancy for this job; are you interested?
example.traditional: 呢份工仲有空缺，你有冇興趣？
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 zung6 jau5 hung1 kyut3 nei5 jau5 mou5 hing3 ceoi3

rows.note: Use this for a hotel or guest-house room that is available for guests.

example.english: The hotel still has a vacancy, so we can check in right away.
example.traditional: 間酒店仲有空房，可以即刻入住。
example.jyutping: gaan1 zau2 dim3 zung6 jau5 hung1 fong2 ho2 ji5 zik1 hak1 jap6 zyu6
